resources.name: DS Electronics Store
resources.description: Player-run electronics job with a three-stage assembly pipeline (collect → process → assemble), a live MySQL retail store, cart checkout, employee stock management, and a fully modular bridge system for notifications, progress bars, prompts, and banking.

resources.name: DS Television
resources.description: Server-synced TV system. Stream YouTube, Twitch, or any website onto in-world TV props. Per-TV distance controls, a custom default image, location-spawned props, and a clean in-game control menu.

resources.name: DS Job Creator
resources.description: In-game admin NUI panel for creating, editing, and managing QBCore jobs on a live server. Live job apply, boss menu and job stash — no restarts required.

resources.name: DS DJ Booths
resources.description: Server-synced DJ booth system with positional 3D audio, a professional music player UI, song history, and full ds_target / qb-target integration.

resources.name: DS Target
resources.description: Drop-in qb-target replacement with the DS Customs dark-glass UI. 8 colour presets, configurable eye reticle, full PolyZone support, and an identical export API.

resources.name: DS Garages
resources.description: Overhauled garage system with live camera preview, ped attendants, and cinematic UI.

resources.name: DS Vehicle Keys
resources.description: Database-backed vehicle lock & key ownership system. Keyfob NUI, hotwiring, carjacking, lockpicking, job-shared keys, and a full server & client export API.

resources.name: DS Minigames
resources.description: Modular minigame library with six original games and four difficulty tiers each. One clean export per game, framework-agnostic, no SQL. Drop-in for lockpicking, hacking, safecracking, and more.

resources.name: DS MDT
resources.description: Full-featured Mobile Data Terminal for law enforcement. Reports, warrants, BOLOs, dispatch, live map, citations, licenses, and more.

resources.name: DS MDT — DOJ
resources.description: Department of Justice terminal for judges, prosecutors, and defense attorneys. Warrant review, motions, hearings, verdicts, court orders, and client management.

resources.name: Enhanced QB Police Job
resources.description: Full-featured Enhanced police job with armory, garage, evidence collection, ANPR, fingerprint DB, file cabinet, weapon registry, security cameras, and dispatch exports.

resources.name: DS Prison Creator
resources.description: Complete in-game jail & prison builder — cells, doors, cameras, outfits, canteen, commissary, visitor check-in, court transport, and full officer management UI.

resources.name: DS Progressbar
resources.description: Standalone cinematic progress bar with 4-corner bracket UI, 8 color presets, cancellable with callback, and live percentage counter. No SQL, no dependencies.

resources.name: DS Prompt
resources.description: Standalone interaction prompt with key badge, 8 color presets, 3 size presets, and 9 position anchors. Caller-supplied key label, auto-hide on press, and flicker-free live updates. No SQL, no dependencies.

resources.name: DS Notify
resources.description: Standalone toast notification system used across all DS Customs & GunSmoke resources. One renderer, one style, zero duplication. No SQL, no dependencies.

resources.name: GS Business Banking
resources.description: Shared business bank accounts for every QBCore job. NPC banker terminals, grade-restricted access, and a full server export & callback API.

resources.name: GS Dispensary Job
resources.description: Full-featured player-run cannabis dispensary job. Plant, grow, harvest, roll joints, stock a live store, bill customers, and manage your crew with mugshot HR. Ships as HotBox Dispensary and White Widow Weed Shop.
